question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Timorous
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is** "Timorous"**.
 
• **"Timorous"** refers to a person who is timid, shy, or easily frightened. (डरपोक)
 
 
• **Example**: *The timorous student avoided speaking up in class discussions.*
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is **"Brazen"** which means bold, shameless, or showing a lack of respect. (बेशर्म)
 
 
• **Example**: *The thief showed a brazen attitude by stealing in daylight.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** "Brazen"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Imbecilic**: It refers to behavior or actions that are extremely foolish. (मूर्ख)
 
• **Muggy**: It refers to very warm and humid weather. (उमस भरा मौसम)
 
• **Badgered**: It refers to harassed persistently. (बार-बार परेशान किया गया)
